svg.title: What bounds one run of the AI
svg.desc: The event job names the task of the run. The engine command chooses from [engine] in config.toml what the run may use: the model, or light_model for a reply to one comment; the turns, all of max_turns for an analysis or a maintainer's question, half for a follow-up and a tenth for a reply; the dollars of max_budget_usd and the effort. The context command writes the rules into rules.md and the task into prompt.md. The engine takes the rules before the task, reads the checkout and stops at its turns or its dollars, as far as it counts them; its answer goes to the job apply. For Claude, the usage command reads the numbers of the run, also after a failure, and writes one line into the summary of the job: the turns, the time, the cost and the tokens. When the run stopped at a limit, a warning names the setting.
